verses.1: And the LORD said to Moses, “Tell the priests, the sons of Aaron, that they must not be buried in their own people’s land.”
verses.2: For if he remains close to his mother, father, brother, sister, and other relatives.
verses.3: And his sister, the close relative who lived with him, was not owned by any man; she was not given to anyone.
verses.4: It shall not be hidden from his people.
verses.5: Their hair shall not become gray, nor shall their heads age. Their voices shall not be hoarse, and their lips shall not become dry.
verses.6: They shall be holy to Him. They shall not profane the name of His God. For Jehovah has made them their bread. They shall be holy.
verses.7: A woman who is divorced and widowed shall not be taken away from her husband. A woman who has been separated from her husband shall not be taken away from her husband either. For she is holy to God.
verses.8: And sanctify it, for this bread of yours is a sacrifice. It becomes holy because I, the LORD, have sanctified it.
verses.9: And in the case of a priest’s wife, if she begins to commit incest with her father, she will be destroyed by fire.
verses.10: And the high priest among his brothers, who is responsible for pouring the holy oil on the head of the person being anointed, must not break the laws related to this act. Nor should he damage the garments or the head of the person being anointed.
verses.11: And from every soul that dies, they will not be brought back to their father and mother. They will not be buried with them.
verses.12: And from the Holy Place, he shall not go forth, nor shall he profane his God’s Holy Place. For I, Jehovah, have set up a golden seal on his forehead as a reminder of this.
verses.13: And he took her as his wife.
verses.14: Almana, Gurusha, and Chalala Zona shall not take any of these women. He may only take a wife from his own people.
verses.15: And its seed shall not be destroyed among its people, for I, the LORD, am holy.
verses.16: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.17: And he said to Aaron, “No one from your descendants who dies shall be able to bring any grain as an offering to the Lord.”
verses.18: For anyone who has died, no one should approach him as a stranger, a sinner, or a wicked person.
verses.19: Or a person who has either a missing leg or a missing hand.
verses.20: Or a mountain, or a cliff, or a hill, or a valley, or a wind.
verses.21: Any man who has died from the lineage of Aaron, the priest, shall not go and offer the sacrifices of the Lord’s altar. He shall not go and offer his own bread as an offering to the Lord.
verses.22: His bread is from the offerings of the holy ones, and he eats from those who are holy.
verses.23: But he shall not enter the tent, and he shall not approach the altar. For it is holy, and I, the LORD, have sanctified it.
verses.24: And Moses spoke to Aaron and his sons, and to all the children of Israel.
